page.overview:
What is Gurathnaka?

Gurathnaka (also known as the Eater of Dreams or Shadow of the Night) is a fictional entity created by Matthew Grau for the role-playing game CthulhuTech.

Gurathnaka is a Great Old One who appears to be a shadowy, incorporeal entity dwelling in the Dreamlands. It is unknown if Gurathnaka ever had a bodily form, as it exists beyond the wall of sleep in dimensions beyond the physical world, only interacting with the corporeal plane through shadows. Many learned occultists have used bright lights to protect themselves from Gurathnaka's shadows, and the few mortals who worship the entity have lost their sanity while dwelling in the shadows of society. (: CthulhuTech Chapter Fourteen "Parting the Veil")
